tools.name: route_punctuality
tools.description: Punctuality statistics for a train route between two German stations (on-time percentage, average delay, cancellation rate, observation count). Uses partial matching so "Berlin" and "München" work (omit "Hbf" or suffixes).

tools.name: station_punctuality
tools.description: Punctuality statistics for a single German station: on-time percentage, average delay, cancellation rate, number of distinct trains observed. Uses partial matching: "Frankfurt Hbf" matches "Frankfurt(Main)Hbf".

tools.name: train_delay_stats
tools.description: Delay statistics for a specific train (e.g. ICE 577): per-station on-time percentage, average/max delay and cancellation rate. Useful to answer "how reliable is this exact train?". Returns a compact station list (default 15, max 50) for token efficiency.

tools.name: chaos_index
tools.description: The Bahn-Chaos-Index: ONE number (0 calm ... 100 chaos) summarizing the state of German rail TODAY: long-distance arrivals at 20 major stations, compared with the median of the previous 28 days up to the same time of day (punctuality 50%, cancellations 30%, average delay 20%).
